section_title: ready: is this install ready for a first ticket
after_docker: Waits for Docker, which does not answer.
docker_todo: Start Docker, and run Cleared under an account of the docker group.
labels_ok: Docker lists by the label cleared.dev=v2: {count} labelled containers.
labels_fail: Docker listed a container without the label cleared.dev=v2: its filters cannot be trusted, and Cleared acts only on what it lists by that label.
labels_todo: Update Docker Engine, then run the doctor again.
images_ok: The session and egress images are there: {images}.
images_error: Docker refused the list of images: {reason}
images_todo: Run the install again from the clone: docker compose -f v2/compose.yaml run --rm install. It builds what is missing.
pool_ok: {free} free subnets in Docker's address pools; a session takes two.
pool_fail: {free} free subnets in Docker's address pools; a session takes two.
pool_error: Docker refused the list of labelled networks: {reason}
pool_todo: Stop the sessions you no longer need, or widen default-address-pools in /etc/docker/daemon.json and restart Docker.
state_ok: The state folder {path} is this account's, and no other account can write in it.
state_unset_todo: Set CLEARED_STATE_DIR, or install with docker compose -f v2/compose.yaml run --rm install, which sets it.
state_missing: There is no state folder at {path}.
state_missing_todo: Run the install from the clone: docker compose -f v2/compose.yaml run --rm install. It makes the folder.
state_owner: The state folder {path} belongs to another account (uid {owner}), and Cleared runs as uid {uid}.
state_owner_todo: Run Cleared as the folder's account, or run the install again, which gives the folder to the clone's owner.
state_open: Other accounts may write in the state folder {path} (mode {mode}).
state_readable: Other accounts can read the state folder {path} (mode {mode}); the install makes it 700.
after_labels: Waits for Docker lists that honour the label filter.
disk_ok: {free} free on the state folder's disk.
disk_low: {free} free on the state folder's disk; the images and each ticket's checkout take several gigabytes.
disk_fail: {free} free on the state folder's disk: too little to build the images.
disk_todo: Free some space on that disk: Cleared needs 5 GB at least, 20 GB to work in comfort.
disk_error: The free space of the state folder's disk could not be read: {reason}
settings_ok: The settings file {path} is there, and only this account can read it.
settings_none: No settings file at {path}: the settings come from the environment, as for an install made by hand.
settings_none_todo: The setup assistant writes it; nothing to do if you set the variables yourself.
settings_open: Other accounts can read the settings file {path} (mode {mode}).
settings_link: The settings file {path} is a link: Cleared does not follow it.
settings_link_todo: Replace the link by the file itself, mode 600.
credentials_ok: The file the settings name for {name} is there, and only this account can read it.
credentials_fail: The file the settings name for {name} is a link, another account's, readable by others, or empty: {path}. Cleared does not set {name} from it.
credentials_todo: Save it again in the setup assistant, or run chmod 600 {path} if it is this account's file.
model_ok: The Claude Code login is there: {path}.
model_empty: The Claude Code login at {path} is empty.
model_not_file: The Claude Code login {path} is not a file.
model_todo: Open the setup assistant's model step and paste what claude setup-token prints.
model_owner: The Claude Code login {path} belongs to another account (uid {owner}).
model_owner_todo: Save it again in the setup assistant, so that it is this account's file.
model_open: Other accounts can read the Claude Code login {path} (mode {mode}).
forge_none: No GitHub token: neither GH_TOKEN nor GITHUB_TOKEN is set.
forge_none_todo: Open the setup assistant's forge step and save a token.
forge_address_todo: Unset CLEARED_V2_FORGE_GITHUB_API, or give an address on loopback.
forge_refused: GitHub refuses the token (401): it is wrong, expired or revoked.
forge_refused_todo: Make a new one on GitHub and save it in the setup assistant's forge step.
forge_forbidden: GitHub forbids the request (403): the token lacks a right, or GitHub's rate limit is reached.
forge_forbidden_todo: Check its rights against the list of the forge step, or try again in an hour.
forge_unreachable: GitHub did not answer within {limit} at {api}.
forge_unreachable_todo: Check that this machine reaches {api}, then run the doctor again.
forge_status: GitHub answered {status} to the token's check.
forge_status_todo: Run the doctor again in a few minutes; GitHub's status page says whether it is down.
after_forge: Waits for a GitHub token that passes.
workspace_none: No workspace yet: no repository is connected.
workspace_none_todo: The setup assistant's workspace step connects one.
workspace_refused_todo: Fix the workspace file CLEARED_V2_WORKSPACE names, or the CLEARED_V2_* settings it repeats.
after_workspace: Waits for workspace settings that are accepted.
repository_ok: {repo} is reached, with the right to push.
repository_missing: {repo} is not reached: the token does not see it (404).
repository_missing_todo: Add {repo} to the token's repositories on GitHub, or fix repo in the workspace file.
repository_refused_todo: Check the token's rights on {repo} against the list of the forge step.
repository_read_only: {repo} is reached, read only: Cleared pushes branches and opens pull requests there.
repository_read_only_todo: Give the token Contents and Pull requests, read and write, on {repo}.
repository_unsaid: {repo} is reached; GitHub did not say what the token may do there.
repository_unreachable: GitHub did not answer about {repo} within {limit}.
repository_unreachable_todo: Run the doctor again; check that this machine reaches {api}.
checkout_ok: The checkout of {service} at {dir} is a clone of its repository, with origin/{base}.
checkout_absent: {service} has no checkout at {dir} yet; the first ticket clones it.
checkout_not_git: {dir} is there, and is not a git checkout.
checkout_not_git_todo: Move that folder away; the first ticket clones {service} there.
checkout_other: {dir} is a clone of another repository than {url}.
checkout_other_todo: Fix url in the workspace file, or move that folder away so that the first ticket clones {service} there.
checkout_no_base: The checkout of {service} at {dir} has no origin/{base}.
checkout_no_base_todo: Check base in the workspace file; the next ticket fetches the checkout.
